title: Password reset confirmation route has no direct API coverage
reasoning: The route for password reset confirmation is registered, and the included password-reset-related tests only verify that the email template renders a frontend reset URL and security copy. None of the included tests exercise POSTing uid/token/new password data to /api/password/reset/confirm/, so URL wiring, request validation, token handling, and response contract can regress without being caught by the shown test set.
recommendation: Add focused API tests for /api/password/reset/confirm/ that cover a valid uid/token password update, invalid or expired token rejection, malformed payload validation, and the expected response status/body.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests cover password reset email rendering, but they do not call the Django route or PasswordResetConfirmView.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a user, generate a Django password reset uid/token, POST them with a new password to /api/password/reset/confirm/, assert the response succeeds and the user can authenticate with the new password; also assert invalid token/payload cases fail without changing the password.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests for PasswordResetConfirmView; no production code change is implied by this finding.
